title: Paperboat run record v0
description: One run of a backend, as `paperboat run --record <dir>` (and `paperboat open --record <dir>`) writes it: record.json next to the project. Plain JSON, diffable, no database (#277). It is not a protocol message; it carries the messages the run sent.

started.description: ISO 8601 UTC when the run started.

name.description: The backend's engine name, as hello.engine.

tool_versions.description: The tool versions that made the record.

command.description: The command line that asked for the run.

flow.description: The graph.run request's graph: flow type, nodes and wires.

station.description: The station the run was given, when it had one.

variables.description: The variables the run resolved against.

settings.description: The run's settings: the backend's defaults with graph.run's overrides.

toolkits.description: The optional toolkits the backend offered, with their installed versions.

signals.description: Every signal sample a monitor sent, in arrival order: what every Board scope saw.

scene.description: Station motion: the scene at the run's start, then each scene.patch on the run clock.

base.description: The entities of the run's opening scene, by id.

t.description: The run clock when the patch arrived.
